description: Read or organise one Hermes session — or patch several at once. get (default) returns the session's label, source, model, pin/archive state and preview. patch sets label (the session's title; empty string clears it), pinned, archived (false restores), or hidden, on one session (session_id, or the current session when omitted) or on up to 100 via targets. Hermes sessions have no groups, so no group action is offered. Pinning keeps a session visible; archiving hides it from the default listing but keeps its messages.
name: sessions

action.description: 'get' reads the row; 'patch' applies the label/pinned/archived/hidden changes.

archived.description: Patch only. True archives the session, false restores it.

hidden.description: Patch only. True hides the session from the default listing, false unhides it.

label.description: Patch only. New title for the session (max 100 chars); empty string clears it.

pinned.description: Patch only. True pins the session, false unpins it.

profile.description: Get only. Read a session from another Hermes profile (read-only); patch writes the current profile only.

session_id.description: Session to read or patch. Omit to target the current session. Cannot be combined with targets.

targets.description: Patch only. Up to 100 session ids to patch identically; cannot be combined with session_id.
